caption: The video captures a hazy coniferous forest interior where a slow, steady drift shifts the foreground trunk left relative to the trunks behind it. A large, lichen-and-moss-covered trunk dominates the left-center foreground, and as the drift proceeds it slides leftward across the view while the vertical trunks receding into the bright mist behind it move only slightly, producing a clear parallax shift. Shafts of sunlight slant down from the upper right through the fog, their glow soft and diffuse. The forest floor and right side are thick with ferns and mossy fallen logs that remain still. No people or animals enter the scene. The view continues drifting, with mist and light still present.
relations: As the view drifts left, the mossy foreground trunk slides leftward across the frame relative to the misted background trunks.
The receding vertical trunks shift only slightly against the bright fog, producing a clear parallax offset from the foreground trunk.
Ferns and mossy fallen logs on the floor and right remain still while the trunk and background trunks parallax.
Slanted sun shafts and soft mist persist overhead as the drift continues, with no people or animals entering.
